thread:
maria: Quick sync — opened a PR to standardize artifact origins for the new model (llama-3-small). HF points at `hf://redwood/llama-3-small/weights` but our S3 mirror is `s3://rw-artifacts/llama3/small/v1`.
jordan: PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifacts/pull/178 — includes manifest + presign config
akshay: Quick q: which checksum algorithm are we using in manifests now? last mirror used blake2b, some of our registry checks expect sha256.
maria: switching manifests to `sha256` for consistency. artifact-bot will validate on publish.
artifact-bot: [bot] Created manifest v1.2 for `llama-3-small` — checksum verification pending mirror sync :hourglass_flowing_sand:
sophie: tokenizer heads-up: this model uses the legacy BPE variant w/o an explicit `<unk>` token. HF tokenizer JSON errors if `<unk>` missing — I added a minimal fallback in our loader to map unknowns to `<pad>` for now.
maria: good catch. please add a unit test under `tests/tokenizer_tests.py` and paste the failing HF snippet in the PR so reviewers see it.
akshay: also, presign TTL — infra default is 12h but the onboarding script expects 1h. Who owns the per-artifact setting?
jordan: infra owns defaults but we've allowed per-manifest override. I saw `presign_ttl: 3600` in your branch.
maria: tagged @infra in PR description and added `presign_ttl: 3600` to manifest. queuing mirror job via deploy-bot now.
deploy-bot: Queued mirror job #4321 for `s3://rw-artifacts/llama3/small/v1`. Est. 9m to completion. Logs: /jobs/4321
sophie: after mirror finishes can someone run `aws s3api head-object` to confirm `Content-Type` and `Content-Length` preserved? last mirror returned `binary/octet-stream` and downstream tooling choked.
akshay: will run head-object as soon as job completes and paste results here.
maria: I'm adding a registry validation step that rejects manifests if checksum mismatch (strict equality). Also documenting the tokenizer fallback in the onboarding notes.
jordan: tiny naming nit: PR uses `weights_uri` vs our canonical `artifact_uri`. prefer `artifact_uri` for clarity across embeddings/weights.
maria: will rename keys to `artifact_uri` in the manifest, update schema, and push a small follow-up commit.
sophie: +1 :+1:
akshay: mirror finished, ran `aws s3api head-object` — output looks good. Content-Type: `application/octet-stream`, Content-Length matches, ETag present. Checksums match our sha256.
artifact-bot: Mirror job #4321 completed successfully. checksum: sha256:ab12ef34c9... (truncated) :white_check_mark:
maria: merging now after I update the key names. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone. I'll follow up with a short post in #docs about tokenizer fallback and presign TTL guidance.
jordan: thanks — will watch for the release note.
sophie: re: tokenizer, we should track a small follow-up to remove fallback once HF tokenizer gets updated. filing a tiny ticket.
maria: filed: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ML-2212 — follow-up to remove fallback and add canonical tokenizer asset to HF.
akshay: LGTM. :rocket:
maria: merging and closing this thread.
